reasons.description: The decision context cannot be read or validated.
reasons.recovery: Rebuild the decision context from validated run state and retry the decision.

reasons.description: The persisted current step differs from the plan's in-progress step.
reasons.recovery: Reconcile the current-step pointer with the single in-progress plan step, validate state, and retry.

reasons.description: The persisted current step does not exist in the active plan.
reasons.recovery: Restore the referenced step in the active plan or clear the orphaned pointer through explicit state recovery.

reasons.description: The active plan contains duplicate step identifiers.
reasons.recovery: Assign a unique identifier to every plan step, validate the plan, and retry.

reasons.description: The active plan contains no executable steps.
reasons.recovery: Add at least one executable step with valid dependencies to the active plan.

reasons.description: The requested feature differs from the feature recorded by the active run.
reasons.recovery: Target the feature owned by the active run or finish that run before selecting another feature.

reasons.description: The active feature state cannot be decoded or validated.
reasons.recovery: Run the state integrity audit and repair or rebuild the active-feature record before continuing.

reasons.description: The active gaps document cannot be decoded or validated.
reasons.recovery: Repair or regenerate the gaps document against its schema, then review the resulting open gaps.

reasons.description: A harness project is missing its required guardrails document.
reasons.recovery: Restore the project guardrails document from the managed template and validate it before continuing.

reasons.description: The required guardrails document cannot be decoded or validated.
reasons.recovery: Correct the guardrails document against its schema and rerun the policy decision.

reasons.description: A required legacy compatibility operation reported failure.
reasons.recovery: Inspect the recorded legacy failure, correct its named prerequisite, and rerun the compatibility operation.

reasons.description: More than one plan step is marked in progress.
reasons.recovery: Recover the plan so exactly one step remains in progress and validate the current-step pointer.

reasons.description: No pending step has all dependencies satisfied.
reasons.recovery: Complete or repair the blocking dependencies, or revise the plan so one pending step becomes runnable.

reasons.description: The pending partition proposal cannot be decoded or validated.
reasons.recovery: Regenerate the partition proposal from the current PRD and validate it before requesting a decision.

reasons.description: The requested run identifier differs from the active run.
reasons.recovery: Reload the active run identifier and address the operation to that run.

reasons.description: The active run state cannot be read or validated.
reasons.recovery: Run the state integrity audit and repair or rebuild the active run state before continuing.

reasons.description: The run exceeded its configured stop-loss budget.
reasons.recovery: Review the exhausted budget and obtain an explicit budget adjustment or stop the run.

reasons.description: The run has an active stop-loss flag requiring release.
reasons.recovery: Review the stop-loss evidence and clear the flag only through the authorized recovery operation.

reasons.description: A plan step names a dependency that is absent from the plan.
reasons.recovery: Correct or remove the unknown dependency identifier, validate the plan graph, and retry.

reasons.description: The project still requires the explicit Brain-layout migration.
reasons.recovery: Run `kratos migrate brain` from the project root, verify the sibling Brain repository, and retry.

reasons.description: The recorded Git baseline is absent, malformed, or inconsistent.
reasons.recovery: Recapture a valid Git baseline for the active code step before requesting completion.

reasons.description: A path ignored at baseline was removed during the code step.
reasons.recovery: Restore the removed ignored path or explicitly revise the step scope before completion.

reasons.description: The observed repository identity changed since execution began.
reasons.recovery: Reload repository identity, recapture the observation, and rerun completion against the current checkout.

reasons.description: Completion cannot find the required active run or step state.
reasons.recovery: Restore or select the active run and code-step state before invoking completion.

reasons.description: The step selected for completion is not the active code step.
reasons.recovery: Reload the active code step and submit completion for that exact step.

reasons.description: The worktree contains a change outside the step's declared scope.
reasons.recovery: Revert the undeclared change or add it to an explicitly reviewed step scope before completion.

reasons.description: The worktree content no longer matches the completion observation.
reasons.recovery: Reobserve the worktree, regenerate completion evidence, and submit the current content.

reasons.description: Dashboard rendering cannot read the canonical trail status.
reasons.recovery: Repair or regenerate the canonical trail status, then reload the dashboard.

reasons.description: Dashboard rendering cannot read the telemetry history.
reasons.recovery: Repair or quarantine the invalid telemetry entry, then reload the dashboard history.

reasons.description: The decision engine observed that every plan step is complete.
The run is waiting for explicit final human acceptance.
reasons.recovery: Review the final evidence and run `kratos done` to record explicit human acceptance.

reasons.description: The run is waiting for explicit approval of the current specification lineage.
reasons.recovery: Review the current specification lineage and approve that exact revision before continuing.

reasons.description: The run is waiting for a human decision on open business gaps.
reasons.recovery: Review every open business gap and record the requested human decision for the active gate.

reasons.description: The run is waiting for a human decision on the partition proposal.
reasons.recovery: Review the current partition proposal and explicitly approve or refuse that exact revision.

reasons.description: The run cannot advance because its required PRD artifact is absent.
reasons.recovery: Generate and validate the required PRD artifact before continuing the run.

reasons.description: Guard evaluation cannot validate the active-feature marker.
reasons.recovery: Repair the active-feature marker against its schema before allowing guarded writes.

reasons.description: Guard evaluation cannot validate project configuration.
reasons.recovery: Correct project configuration against its schema before rerunning the guard.

reasons.description: Guard evaluation cannot find required project configuration.
reasons.recovery: Restore the managed project configuration and validate it before rerunning the guard.

reasons.description: The requested target is outside guard jurisdiction and produced a non-blocking warning.
Guard evaluation cannot validate the guardrails document.
reasons.recovery: Correct the guardrails document against its schema before rerunning the guard.

reasons.description: Guard evaluation cannot find the guardrails document.
reasons.recovery: Restore the managed guardrails document before allowing guarded writes.

reasons.description: The requested write is outside every configured allow rule.
reasons.recovery: Move the change inside an allowed scope or obtain an explicit reviewed scope update.

reasons.description: Guard evaluation cannot validate the project marker.
reasons.recovery: Repair the project marker against its managed contract before rerunning the guard.

reasons.description: Guard evaluation cannot validate the active scope document.
reasons.recovery: Correct the active scope document against its schema before rerunning the guard.

reasons.description: The active scope explicitly denies the requested write.
reasons.recovery: Choose a permitted target or obtain an explicit reviewed change to the deny policy.

reasons.description: The requested write targets a protected specification artifact.
reasons.recovery: Use the specification workflow that owns the protected artifact instead of editing it directly.

reasons.description: The requested code write precedes approval of the current specification.
reasons.recovery: Approve the current specification lineage before attempting the code write.

reasons.description: The guard could not inspect the requested target and produced a non-blocking warning.
A configured write-block rule matches the requested target.
reasons.recovery: Choose an unblocked target or obtain an explicit reviewed guardrail change.

reasons.description: The observed executor and judge are the same while self-judgment is forbidden.
reasons.recovery: Run judgment with a distinct authorized judge identity or explicitly enable permitted self-judgment.

reasons.description: The observed judge model differs from the required judge model.
reasons.recovery: Select the required judge model and rerun judgment with fresh model evidence.

reasons.description: The orchestration loop reached a deterministic blocked decision.
reasons.recovery: Inspect the decision reason and complete its named recovery before restarting the loop.

reasons.description: The orchestration loop is explicitly halted and cannot select more work.
reasons.recovery: Inspect the terminal or blocked decision that halted the loop before requesting more work.

reasons.description: The orchestration loop found the next step ready for execution.
The orchestration loop stopped after reaching its stop-loss condition.
reasons.recovery: Review the stop-loss evidence and obtain an authorized budget or policy decision before restarting.

reasons.description: The completion baseline intentionally represents a project without a Git repository.
The decision engine selected the next runnable plan step.
The decision engine selected the already in-progress step for resumption.
An unexpected internal failure was sanitized before reaching normal output.
reasons.recovery: Capture an authorized redacted diagnostic bundle and report the stable reason without blindly retrying.

reasons.description: Another unexpired fenced lease owns the requested mutation.
reasons.recovery: Wait for the valid lease to finish or expire, reload canonical state, and request the mutation again.

reasons.description: A durable transaction marker requires explicit verified recovery.
reasons.recovery: Run the explicit transaction recovery operation, verify its event evidence, and then repeat the original request.

reasons.description: Canonical state changed after the decision input was loaded.
reasons.recovery: Reload canonical state, recompute the decision from the new revision, and submit a fresh mutation.

reasons.description: Snapshot, event-chain, or canonical-state integrity validation failed.
reasons.recovery: Preserve the rejected state, run the explicit integrity audit, and retry only after verified repair or rebuild.

reasons.description: Final acceptance was requested before all readiness conditions were satisfied.
reasons.recovery: Complete every outstanding readiness condition and regenerate final evidence before requesting acceptance.

reasons.description: The supplied gate does not equal the active pending gate.
reasons.recovery: Reload the active pending gate and submit the decision for that exact gate.

reasons.description: The maintenance operation requires interactive terminal input.
reasons.recovery: Rerun the maintenance operation from an interactive terminal.

reasons.description: The project is not yet operating in trail mode and receives migration orientation.
A different active objective was supplied without explicit replacement.
reasons.recovery: Keep the active objective or explicitly request replacement with the new objective text.

reasons.description: The requested trail operation completed successfully.
A required phase output is absent, malformed, or inconsistent.
reasons.recovery: Regenerate the required phase output for the active run and validate it before continuing.

reasons.description: The PRD checkpoint is absent, malformed, or not completed.
reasons.recovery: Complete or regenerate the PRD with valid required fields, then rerun the checkpoint.

reasons.description: No active feature run exists for the requested trail operation.
Specification revision was requested from an incompatible gate or state.
reasons.recovery: Return to the specification-approval gate before requesting a specification revision.

reasons.description: Final acceptance must use the dedicated done operation instead of continue.
reasons.recovery: Run `kratos done` instead of `kratos continue` for final acceptance.

reasons.description: The trail command arguments do not satisfy the operation usage contract.
reasons.recovery: Correct the command arguments according to the operation usage and invoke it again.

reasons.description: A code step cannot start or rebaseline with disallowed worktree changes.
reasons.recovery: Commit, stash, or revert disallowed worktree changes, then retry the code-step operation.

reasons.description: The installed plugin version identifier is missing or malformed.
reasons.recovery: Reinstall a complete plugin release with a valid version manifest.

reasons.description: The installed plugin version is not supported by this runtime.
reasons.recovery: Install the complete plugin release selected by the compatibility manifest.

reasons.description: The host contract version identifier is missing or malformed.
reasons.recovery: Upgrade the host adapter so it declares a valid contract version.

reasons.description: The host contract version is not supported by this runtime.
reasons.recovery: Use a host adapter version accepted by the compatibility manifest.

reasons.description: The persisted state contract identifier is missing or malformed.
reasons.recovery: Inspect the project state metadata and authorize explicit recovery before continuing.

reasons.description: The persisted state contract is not supported by this runtime.
reasons.recovery: Create and authorize an explicit migration plan for the persisted project state.

reasons.description: The interpreter running the plugin runtime is older than the supported minimum.
reasons.recovery: Install Node.js 24.0.0 or newer and run the command again.

reasons.description: The runtime published orientation output without changing state.
The run cannot advance because its PRD still matches the untouched feature template.
reasons.recovery: Replace the PRD template guidance with the feature's requirements before continuing the run.

reasons.description: The run cannot advance because its PRD is missing a named required section.
reasons.recovery: Add the required section named by the gate failure and complete its requirements before continuing the run.

reasons.description: The task document does not declare acceptance criteria.
reasons.recovery: Declare identified criteria in the active task document and retry.

reasons.description: The task document contains a malformed acceptance criterion identifier.
reasons.recovery: Correct the identifier to the published acceptance criterion grammar and retry.

reasons.description: The task document declares an acceptance criterion identifier more than once.
reasons.recovery: Give every declared criterion a unique identifier without reusing a frozen identifier.

reasons.description: The frozen acceptance criterion baseline cannot be verified from run history.
reasons.recovery: Restore the event-referenced snapshot or bootstrap it from exact plan lineage.

reasons.description: A frozen acceptance criterion declaration was changed, removed, reordered, or renumbered.
reasons.recovery: Restore the frozen declaration and append a new identifier during acceptance if needed.

reasons.description: An acceptance criterion was appended outside the acceptance phase.
reasons.recovery: Remove the appended declaration or add it through the acceptance phase.

reasons.description: An acceptance criterion checkbox differs from the runtime-recorded verdict.
reasons.recovery: Restore the tracked checkbox state and let acceptance recording update it.

reasons.description: The acceptance verdict does not cover every declared criterion exactly once.
reasons.recovery: Report one outcome for every declared identifier and align the global verdict.

reasons.description: An acceptance criterion outcome has no matching evidence record.
reasons.recovery: Record evidence for the criterion and cite its exact reference in the verdict.

reasons.description: The evidence cited by an acceptance criterion does not pass integrity validation.
reasons.recovery: Restore or record digest-valid evidence and retry the acceptance verdict.

reasons.description: At least one acceptance criterion is not passed, checked, and evidence-valid.
reasons.recovery: Resolve the named criterion and record a complete evidence-bound verdict.

reasons.description: The requested target escapes the project root after canonical inspection.
reasons.recovery: Choose a project-relative target that resolves inside the project root and retry the guarded write.

reasons.description: The guard cannot safely inspect the requested mutation target.
reasons.recovery: Provide a supported structured mutation with inspectable target paths and retry the guarded write.
